units.en: Hearts of Iron IV has 293 (191 on Xbox) different ⟦0⟧, all using the Steam or Xbox achievements mechanics. Achievements have no in-game effects; the achievement just pops up in-game, and is then added to the player's Steam or Xbox profile depending on the version of the game. It is possible to see the achievements sorted by the percentage of users that managed to complete each achievement by going to the game's global achievements at Steam or by using the built-in Sort options in the Xbox achievements list.

Achievements can only be gained in single-player ⟦0⟧ games, with the 1936 start, on ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ difficulty. (30 Minutes of Hel and Don’t Die for Your Country can only be completed in the 1939 start date). They can be earned while playing older versions of the game as long as said achievements were present in that version. They can also be earned with ⟦4⟧ set to off. (Note: There is no "end date", the game can be continued indefinitely)

It is not possible to gain achievements if the ⟦0⟧ has been changed - either by tampering with game files, or by running the game using mods that affect gameplay mechanics (graphical mods do not affect checksum), or a corrupted installation.

Please note that the Xbox version of the game is no longer kept up to parity with Steam since March 1st, 2024⟦0⟧ and as such, the Xbox version does not have achievements for Trial of Allegiance and will not receive any future expansions.
Setting AI behavior for achievement runs

Although changing custom game rules usually locks a game out of being eligible for achievements, using the tab "AI Behavior" along with unchecking Historical AI Focuses can allow you to haphazardly preset what nations you want to be historical or not.

Uncheck ⟦0⟧ Go into Custom Game Rules and into the AI behavior tab. Changing a country's path from ⟦1⟧ to a defined path makes the game non-iron man, but not if you specifically select the historical route, e.g. changing ⟦2⟧'s path from ⟦3⟧ to ⟦4⟧. Now change every country you want to stay historical from ⟦5⟧ to their ironman-compatible set path, with every country you want to possibly go a-historical still set on ⟦6⟧. This way, the game will only have countries with Default set as their path possibly go non-historical, though it is not guaranteed.
This allows you to, for example:

Only set ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, which will possibly make them go non-historical and not attack the ⟦2⟧, who will, in turn, not join the Allies. This is especially useful for world conquest runs as it allows you to beat the Allies after 1941.
Only set ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, which possibly makes the UK disband the Allies. Again, very useful for runs in which you have to beat the Allies.
Note that other countries might still go non-historical although you set them to their historical path, likely due to focuses from a-historical nations influencing these.
The descriptions on this page are taken from the in-game achievement list; the descriptions on Steam (or other platforms) may be different.
The ⟦0⟧ column includes clarifying information regarding the achievement and helpful tips/guides. Please keep this section concise and as short as possible.
The column denotes achievements which can't be completed without the use of DLC mechanics (currently 92 out of 249). Multiple expansion icons mean either can be used.
The ⟦0⟧ column indicates in which version a certain achievement was added. Achievements cannot be earned prior to the version they were added in.
The ⟦0⟧ column indicates the achievement's difficulty level. It can be changed according to player consensus.
The difficulty levels are:⟦0⟧ = Very Easy,⟦1⟧ = Easy,⟦2⟧ = Medium,⟦3⟧ = Hard,⟦4⟧ = Very Hard,⟦5⟧ = Insane,⟦6⟧ = Uncategorized.
Play as ⟦0⟧, right click on the ⟦1⟧, click "Ask to join Faction", and click "Send" on the pop-up. It's that simple.
Can be completed as any country, but play as ⟦0⟧ on historical, for example, if you want to AFK.
In faction with Germany Germany is a faction leader
On historical mode, simply go down the focus path towards ⟦0⟧. Note: The faction does not need be the Axis, but it must be led by Germany.
We'll Build it in a DayResearch Construction V.
Stack up as many bonuses to research speed (especially industrial research speed) as possible and rush your way down the industrial branch. Eventually, you will reach Construction V.
As the United States or United Kingdom, set all of your Naval dockyards to convoy production and stay out of any wars.

This achievement is ideally tackled as a nation that can receive more than just the standard nuclear research bonus in the generic focus tree. Germany is an ideal choice if one goes Democratic, given that on top of a bonus to nuclear weapons, it can get an ahead of time bonus on nukes.

Follow the strategy for Poland Can Into Space achievement and simply research additional technologies.

For detailed strategies, see United Netherlands (achievement)

Has surrendered Has capitulated After Dec 31st, 1947
Flip to fascism through an advisor or national foci, and join the Axis. Do not join any wars. Just AFK until 1948.
Master of WarFully research a land, air and naval doctrine tree.

Just play as the United Kingdom and go down the Revisit Colonial Policy branch to release all occupied land as puppets.

On historical mode, start as Luxembourg and do absolutely nothing. Save up 750+ political power. When Germany declares war on you, make sure to join the Allies. Since you have no divisions, the Germans will capitulate you almost immediately. Once capitulated, change your conscription law to Scraping the Barrel, and the achievement should fire.
Poland Can Into SpaceHas completed the Special Project Rocket Interceptor.

Concede territory to avoid wars and just research. Even when you get overrun and conquered by Germany and/or the Soviet Union, you will continue the game as a government-in-exile hosted by the United Kingdom and remain eligible for the achievement. As long as the Allies survive, you can continue doing research to get the achievement.
True BlitzkriegAs Germany have both Poland and France surrender before January 1st 1940.
Before Jan 1st, 1940 France either: Does not exist Has capitulated Has surrendered Poland does not exist or has capitulated

Both nations need to be either capitulated or annexed. Neither of them can be a puppet. For detailed strategies, see True Blitzkrieg

Playing as either: Denmark Finland Norway Sweden

On historical mode, play as Finland. Wait for world tension to reach 50% so you can do the Northern Defense Front national focus, which makes a faction and invites the other Scandinavian countries to it. The AI should join if it is not already in a faction.

Go down the Unify the Nationalist Front path, win the civil war, and head for Join the Axis. Join the war once Germany attacks the Benelux and gain enough war score for Germany to give you control of Ile de France (16).

Even if the civil war hasn't ended, capitulating one of the other factions (Anarchists/Fascists/Carlists) in the civil war as the Republicans will trigger the achievement.
The Revolution TriumphantHave Germany as a puppet of Soviet.
Follow the historical route, or immediately declare war on Poland and then Germany.
Once More MateOccupy Gallipoli as Australia.

You need to move your fleet into the Black Sea before Turkey remilitarises the Bosphorus Strait. You can increase its range by basing it in Cyprus. Go down the Empower the Workers path towards Join Comintern. Justify a wargoal on Turkey and attack from the Soviet Union. Turkey will guard Istanbul, but leave Erdine undefended. Call them into the war and naval invade Edirne (341). The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.
Forge of VictoryHave 50 factories as Belgium.

Naval dockyards count toward total factories. Simply go Fascist and conquer Netherlands and Luxembourg. If you end up at war with the Allies, don't worry. Simply join the Axis. When Germany punches into France through your territory and capitulates them, you will occupy all of France, thus giving you the necessary factories.

You only need to occupy the state. Turn fascist and justify on Denmark. Build ~10 submarines and declare war. Capture a port in Greenland and then invade Iceland. Note that you cannot be in a faction with countries outside South America.

After securing the Mediterranean, it can easily be done with a small 1944 strategic bomber fleet (without any escort) by taking control of Gibraltar (118), Azores (698), and Bermuda (696).

Simply follow the guide for True Blitzkrieg which will put Western Europe under your control. At this point, it should be easy to launch an invasion on Yorkshire (130) and Northumberland (131). Get intel on the United Kingdom or call Italy into the war to help with gaining naval superiority. The British Isles will be weakly defended, and once you have a stable port beachhead, it should be trivial to conquer them.
One EmpireUnite the entire world under the British Empire.

This is achievement requires a lot of grinding. Go Fascist and keep the empire from falling apart. Take out the United States early and give their territory to Canada to form the Dominion of North America. Later forming the Imperial Federation will then also include the US, giving one of the highest core population possible in the game, especially after also integrating Europe by forming the European Federation. Make sure to justify on as many smaller countries as possible while at war with a major power to speed up the process. Pairs well with New World Order.
